i.norm: Verifies that reading past the end of a GroupedRandomAccessSource returns -1 (end-of-source) while the reported length still reflects the configured window size. Setup: a single 807-byte window (declared length 807) layered over a 6-byte backing array, wrapped in a GroupedRandomAccessSource. The grouped source therefore advertises a length of 807. The read targets a position and buffer offset that lie outside the available data, so nothing is read and -1 is returned.
Backing storage and the buffer the read will (attempt to) fill.
Build the window: offset 807, length 807 over the 6-byte backing array.
Group containing the single window source.
Read starting at position 196, writing into the buffer at offset 1318 for 1318 bytes: all of these lie beyond the available data, so the read yields end-of-source.
